policy: Art assets: CC0 1.0 (public domain) only, downloaded from the official sites (polyhaven.com, ambientcg.com, kenney.nl, quaternius.com, poly.pizza with the CC0 filter; the CC0 MakeHuman core assets via the MPFB2 extension). Every file below public/assets/ is listed here with its source. Voices (public/voice/, listed under voices): synthetic MOSS-TTS-v1.5 clips only (Apache-2.0 model, our output CC0-1.0), one entry per voice; never ElevenLabs output, never a real person's voice. See docs/ART-DIRECTION.md §8.

assets.name: MakeHuman core assets via MPFB 2.0.18 (base mesh hm08, body and face targets, expression units, game_engine rig and weights)
assets.author: MakeHuman Community (Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius, Jonas Hauquier and contributors)
assets.modified: People (featured / extra tier) built by our Blender scripts (scripts/chars/mpfb, spec specs/guide.json): an invented generic placeholder guide, body and face shaped with MakeHuman targets, expression units baked in (smile / blink kept as morphs), body decimated to the featured budget; our own brows, eyes, softshell outfit, walking shoes, lanyard and badge; every colour baked into vertex colours with ONE shared material (kqchar/palette.py) and a decimated LOD1 mesh (kqchar/lod.py); meshopt compressed (pnpm assets:pack). No MakeHuman asset packs used. The MPFB extension (GPL-3.0 code, https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/mpfb/) runs only at build time and is not shipped.

assets.name: Adventurer animation clips (retargeted)
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.modified: Idle, Walk, Run, Interact and Wave of the Adventurer already in the repo (models/camera/surveyor.glb) bake-retargeted onto the MakeHuman game_engine rig of the MPFB people (scripts/chars/mpfb/retarget.py: rotation transfer with rest-pose alignment, hips motion scaled to our hip height, foot lock), plus Point: the retargeted Interact with the reaching hand posed to point

assets.name: MakeHuman core assets via MPFB 2.0.18 (base mesh hm08, body and face targets, expression units, game_engine rig and weights)
assets.author: MakeHuman Community (Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius, Jonas Hauquier and contributors)
assets.modified: Player character built by our Blender scripts (scripts/chars/mpfb, from specs/player.json): body and face shaped with MakeHuman targets, expression units baked in (smile / blink kept as morphs), head enlarged and the face stylised, body decimated; our own solid hair and facial details, eyes, accessories and outfits (a default outfit and a court costume) as separate meshes on the same rig; vertex-colour palette with baked occlusion; meshopt compressed (pnpm assets:pack). No MakeHuman asset packs used. The MPFB extension (GPL-3.0 code, https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/mpfb/) runs only at build time and is not shipped.

assets.name: Adventurer animation clips (retargeted)
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.modified: The 16 clips of the Adventurer already in the repo (models/camera/surveyor.glb) bake-retargeted onto the MakeHuman game_engine rig of the MPFB player (scripts/chars/mpfb/retarget.py: rotation transfer with rest-pose alignment, hips motion scaled to our hip height, arms swung out a little to clear the trunk, straighter planted legs, an upright standing pose, relaxed fingers, foot lock)
